name: python-elimination-program
description: Four coordinated Agent Skills plus a PreToolUse hook that stop AI agents defaulting to Python in projects that do not use it. whacking-day (justify it and get the user's OK), zartan (a non-Python option wins if one exists) and jake-the-snake (approved Python is written properly) run in order; old-willy is the merit test for any 'Python is the best tool' claim. The hook blocks Python at the harness when nothing has been authorised.
